newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PetroFina seeks full control of U.S. unit Fina.
newsitem.headline: PetroFina seeks full control of U.S. unit Fina.

text.p: Belgian oil and energy group PetroFina said Tuesday it was looking to take full control of its U.S. subsidiary Fina Inc. for $266 million.
Under the deal PetroFina would offer Fina shareholders $60 per share. The bid aims to raise the stake held by PetroFina and its affiliates in Fina to 100 percent from the current 85.4 percent.
The total value of the transaction was estimated at $266 million, PetroFina said.
PetroFina also said that it intended to seek a listing of its shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The decisions were made at a special meeting of the board of directors held Tuesday, PetroFina said.
Whether Fina shareholders would get PetroFina shares, cash, or an option of either was still the subject of negotiations with independent directors of Fina.
PetroFina said it would seek to buy back any PetroFina shares issued as a result of the proposed takeover to avoid increasing the total number of shares outstanding.
An NYSE listing would give PetroFina improved access to U.S. capital markets, it said.
